messages:
Priyanka (PM): quick sync — customer X pushed back: they need per-route token cost + error-slice dashboards before we flip the canary. can we map what 'ready for launch' actually means?
Mike (eng-runtime): +1. main engineering asks: tracing hooks for prefix/KV cache misses, and a lightweight per-request cost tag in the headers so Console can surface it.
Sasha (eng-sre): we also need a SLO for tail latency and error-rate on the canary. otherwise ops will get paged constantly. recommend 99th < 250ms and p50 < 50ms for the canary.
Ana (design): from UX — customers want a single landing view: top routes, cost delta vs baseline, and a list of recent error slices. Mockup incoming by EOD.
Tim (eng-platform): implementation notes: adding cost tags means touching routing layer. cost attribution stubbed in 2 phases: (1) per-request token estimate, (2) later attach actual GPU time from dataplane. phase 1 is small and unblockable.
Eva (customer-success): customer X says the dashboard must show cost per-embedding call separately. they'll sign once cost delta is visible. small legal asks re: PII in traces (we need to strip prompt text).
Priyanka (PM): ok owners: Mike -> tracing hooks + header; Tim -> cost headers + rollout plan; Ana -> dashboard mocks; Sasha -> SLO and alert runbook; Eva -> verify legal/CS acceptance criteria.
Mike (eng-runtime): question: sampling vs full trace. for high throughput routes we should sample at 1% but keep full traces for errors. plan: sample p=0.01, always capture on error flag.
Sasha (eng-sre): agree. also propose a temporary anomaly detector on error-rate spikes during canary, threshold: +5x baseline sustained for 2m.
Priyanka (PM): launch criteria proposal (draft): 1) dashboard MVP with per-route cost and error slices; 2) tracing hooks enabled with sampling + error capture; 3) canary SLOs met for 48h; 4) CS signoff from customer trial.
Ana (design): sharing initial Figma: https://redwood.app/figma/obs-cost-dashboard (link only internal). layout: left nav filters, middle heatmap for routes, right panel for slices.
Tim (eng-platform): infra impact: adding header increases request metadata by ~120B. negligible. but we need a schema change in event pipeline (schema v3). I'll schedule a migration and keep backwards compat for 2 weeks.
Mike (eng-runtime): dev note: sample config will look like: ```json
{"trace_sampling": 0.01, "always_capture_on_error": true, "emit_cost_estimate": true}
```
Priyanka (PM): dependencies list: - schema migration (Tim) - design mocks (Ana) - legal PII checklist (Eva/Legal) - metrics naming convention (Sasha)
Sasha (eng-sre): metrics naming: use `redwood.obs.request_cost_per_route` and `redwood.obs.error_slice_count`. will add docs to ops playbook.
Eva (customer-success): following up with customer X to get their top 6 routes and test dataset. they can start canary next week if perf looks good.
Priyanka (PM): risks: (a) cost estimates could be off vs real GPU time — communicate as 'estimates' in UI, (b) traces must be scrubbed before retention, (c) dashboards might need more cardinality controls.
Ana (design): UI will include a toggle: Show estimate vs raw (when available). also add grouping controls to avoid cardinality explosion.
Tim (eng-platform): rollout plan: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback if SLO breach. config flags: `obs_canary_percent`, `obs_cost_mode`. I'll add a canary dashboard.
Priyanka (PM): timeline ask: minimal launch for customer in 3 weeks. is that realistic?
Mike (eng-runtime): 3 weeks is tight but doable if we phase: week1 tracing hooks + sampling; week2 cost headers + schema migration; week3 dashboards + canary. Need 1 extra sprint for fixes.
Sasha (eng-sre): ops runway: give us 48h post-canary to validate SLOs before widening.
Eva (customer-success): I'll lock in customer's availability for canary next Tue.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: obs-tracing-hooks branch -> staging (build #4523).
Priyanka (PM): next steps: - Mike/TIm sync right after this to align header/schema work - Ana drop mocks by EOD - Sasha write SLO playbook draft - Eva confirm customer dataset. I'll send a follow-up doc with the acceptance checklist. :thumbsup:
